solution_summary: The Bossard Group (SWX: BOSN) is a leading global provider of industrial fastening and assembly technology solutions and services. Because Bossard leadership had such a clear vision of the analytics they wanted, the implementation team designed for centralized master data management with export to Azure Data Lake. Bossard was already using Dynamics 365 Sales and Marketing productively since they were rolled out between 2019 and 2021, with the support of implementation partner Wϋrth Phoenix. In mid-2022, with assistance from implementation partner HSO, Denmark and Sweden were first to go live with Dynamics 365 Finance, and Supply Chain Management. The Proven Productivity approach includes optimizing processes and reducing inventory to sustainably increase efficiency and productivity.

Companies from local businesses to multinationals count on Bossard’s expertise to increase their productivity.
The Bossard Group generated CHF 1,153.8 million in sales in FY2022.

Investing in Dynamics 365 supports our approach and is already improving our business processes and results.” Daniel Bossard, CEO, Bossard Group Productivity requires the right parts In the industrial fastener business, every improvement, however small, can have a significant positive impact.

Changing the game In the new end-to-end process, approved quotations flow into Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management for fulfillment activities, and ultimately to Dynamics 365 Finance for billing and accounting functions.
By 2020, the company had 12 separate ERP systems, including SAP and Oracle applications, among others, with hundreds of integrations to manage.
The application landscape was fragmented and unable to scale to meet the business’s near- and long-term needs.
It was essential for everyone, at every location, to begin collaborating better through integrated workflows built around a central source of data.
Change management on such a large scale is challenging—and it’s even harder if employees don’t feel heard.

“The technology from Microsoft and Dynamics 365 is pushing us to collaborate and create together in order to provide value for the company and our customers.” 2 The Bossard team's change management approach Successful solutions start with the end in mind To go live in the new cloud environment smoothly and on time, Bossard and HSO teams developed a blueprint for the design and plans for testing, data migration, and integrations.
